name: OpenAI Stargate Lordstown

timeline.event: Land clearing begins in the front of the site (the side facing the Ohio Turnpike), clearing away a parking lot and solar array
Still no visible construction, although construction within preexisting facilities
Active construction visible on and around the datacenter, with the roofing mostly in place. This is based on satellite imagery. No buildings operational yet.

Projected operational date. OpenAI stated Lordstown and Milam County could scale to 1.5 GW within 18 months of their September 23, 2025 announcement; subtracting Milam County's subsequently disclosed 1.2 GW capacity implies ~300 MW for…

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: OpenAI Stargate Lordstown: current power 0 MW; owner Softbank.

explain: OpenAI Stargate Lordstown is an under-construction AI data center in Warren, OH, owned by softbank and used by openai. Epoch AI estimates it draws 0 MW today and 300 MW when finished.
